DebitMemoLineTax.name: DebitMemoLineTax
DebitMemoLineTax.description: Represents the tax information for a debit memo line.

BillingAddressId.description: The billing address specified in the parent debit memo line.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: Required. The currency ISO code of the corporate currency.

DebitMemoLineId.description: Required. The parent debit memo line that the debit memo tax line is related to.

DebitMemoLineTaxNumber.description: Required. An auto-generated number that identifies a debit memo line tax.

Description.description: The description of the debit memo line tax.

EndDate.description: The end date of the debit memo line tax that determines which billing cycle it's associated with.

JurisdictionTaxCode.description: The code of the jurisdiction that's used to calculate the tax rate for the parent debit memo line.

JurisdictionTaxName.description: The user-defined name for the debit memo line tax.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed a debit memo line tax record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed a debit memo line tax record. If this value is null, it’s possible that the user only accessed the debit memo line tax record or a related list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed the debit memo line tax record itself.

LegalEntityAccountingPeriodId.description: The legal entity accounting period record associated with the debit memo line.

LegalEntityId.description: The legal entity record associated with the debit memo line.

ShipFromAddressId.description: The shipping address specified in the parent debit memo line.

StartDate.description: The start date of the debit memo line tax that determines which billing cycle it's associated with.

TaxAmount.description: Required. The total amount of the debit memo line tax.

TaxRate.description: The percentage that's used to calculate tax amount based on the charge amount.

TaxTransactionNumber.description: The transaction number in the external tax engine that calculated the tax for the parent debit memo line.

DebitMemoLineTax.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and the Tax Admin permission set to access this object
